pruneRequires: deleted_at is at least 45 days old
route source watermark and reconciliation checkpoint are strictly newer than the tombstone generation
no active or retained due_work row references the item identity
no nonterminal PCF work references the item identity
a verified off-box backup covers the tombstone
the current release rollback proof is older than the tombstone

terminalPruneRequires: terminal_at is at least 90 days old
retain_until is not null and is in the past
due instant plus the kind-specific lateness deadline is in the past
planner rejects the same old due instant before insert
source and planner checkpoints are newer than the decision watermark
no active item or work row references the semantic key
a verified off-box backup covers the terminal decision
legacy suppression horizon and rollback margin have elapsed
dueWork.latenessContract: R12 may select at most 30 days; a longer value reopens R14 before schema freeze

indexes.itemsActive: partial index over serving keys where deleted_at is null
indexes.itemsTombstonePrune: partial index over deleted_at and route where deleted_at is not null
indexes.dueReady: partial index over kind, next_attempt_at, priority, created_at for claimable nonterminal statuses
indexes.dueTerminalPrune: partial index over retain_until and id for compact terminal statuses
indexes.partitioning: none initially; reconsider only at measured partition-scale volume or maintenance pressure
